answer.text: Before leaving a roundabout, look right, check the mirror and signal the exit.

teaching.text: The key point is: Before leaving a roundabout, look right, check the mirror and signal the exit. Remember: exit. Keep the condition with the rule: Before leaving a roundabout, look right, check the mirror and signal the exit.

recap.narration_text: Keep these reminders connected to their full rules: stop. red. yellow. Work-zone flaggers direct vehicles to stop, slow or travel through the work area. Flaggers use red flags or stop-and-slow paddles and wear orange outer clothing. On a vertical traffic signal, red is above yellow and green is below yellow.

Keep these reminders connected to their full rules: Yellow. safe. yellow. Yellow center markings divide traffic traveling in opposing directions. Stay right of a single broken yellow centerline; cross it to pass or turn only when safe. Double solid yellow centerlines prohibit crossing for a pass, but the guide allows crossing them for a turn.

Keep these reminders connected to their full rules: left. direction. two. A shared center left-turn lane is outlined with both solid and broken yellow markings. Traffic from either direction may use the shared center lane for a left turn. A two-way center left-turn lane may not be used to pass or to continue traveling along the road.
